sentences: 5 similar listed companies trade at 21.5x to 30.3x their yearly profit (middle: 25.7x), at today's market prices.
Applied to its earnings per share of ₹4.41 in Q1FY27 (₹17.64 for a full year), a share would be worth ₹379.01 (low), ₹453.11 (middle) or ₹534.57 (high).
Against the top of the price band, ₹289, the middle value means 56.8% upside.
Q1FY27 covers only part of a year; scaling it up assumes the rest of the year goes the same way.
Cross-check: at the peers' middle EV/EBITDA of 15.8x, after taking off net debt, a share would be worth ₹460.24 against ₹453.11 from P/E: the two agree.
This is a rough guide, not a forecast: it assumes the company deserves the same price tag as its listed peers.
